research_question: Does the information content of relative 2Y front-end repricing improve when the repricing direction is aligned with point-in-time macro pressure consistent with the local-vs-US central-bank reaction function?

frozen_parent_model.feature: monthly change in local-minus-USD 2Y yield differential
frozen_parent_model.rule: Reuse the exact parent-model OOS predictions and returns. Alignment is a post-prediction diagnostic stratification only.

alignment_definition.note: This first conditional test does not claim to reconstruct historical central-bank communication. It asks whether inflation/labour pressure, known point-in-time, supports the direction of front-end repricing expected from a central-bank reaction function.

inputs.inflation: strict/reconstructed certified point-in-time headline inflation history available at the decision snapshot
inputs.labour: strict/reconstructed certified point-in-time unemployment/labour history available at the decision snapshot
inputs.rates: certified temporal-PIT local and USD 2Y rates used in PR #122

relative_macro_components.inflation_pressure: sign(change in local inflation known at t minus change in USD inflation known at t)
relative_macro_components.labour_pressure: sign(-(change in local unemployment known at t minus change in USD unemployment known at t))
relative_macro_components.front_end_repricing: sign(change in local-minus-USD 2Y differential at t)

state_rules.ALIGNED: both inflation_pressure and labour_pressure have the same non-zero sign as front_end_repricing
state_rules.MIXED: exactly one of inflation_pressure or labour_pressure has the same non-zero sign as front_end_repricing, or one macro component is zero while the other agrees
state_rules.CONTRADICTORY: neither macro component supports front_end_repricing and at least one component has the opposite non-zero sign
state_rules.UNAVAILABLE: required point-in-time macro inputs are missing; observation is excluded from state performance but counted in coverage diagnostics

predeclared_evaluation.primary: Performance of the frozen PR #122 OOS strategy conditional on ALIGNED observations
comparators: same frozen OOS strategy on MIXED observations
same frozen OOS strategy on CONTRADICTORY observations

interpretation_policy.if_gate_passes: Evidence for a conditional information layer, not authorization for production sizing or trading.
interpretation_policy.if_gate_fails: Treat relative 2Y repricing as contextual information only; do not tune the alignment definition to rescue the result.
